name: dclab-notebook-companion
description: Read-only, evidence-linked DCLab suggestions beneath VS Code notebook cells.

dclabNotebook.repoPath.description: Path to the DCLab R&D repo; leave empty when the notebook is inside that workspace.

dclabNotebook.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter with access to dclab_rnd. Defaults to <repo>/.venv/bin/python.

dclabNotebook.autoReview.description: Refresh read-only suggestions when notebook cells change. No cells are executed or sent to a provider.
